title: The Super Models
subtitle: The one in which the work AI feels strangely familiar.
lesson: The company makes the model; the app is just where you shop it.
emotionalBeat: The work one is not a mystery; it can be a familiar model in a different store.
oneLineDescription: The one in which the work AI feels strangely familiar.
episodeDescription: A 90s-supermodel guide to the difference between an AI model and the app that sells access to it.
previously: She went looking for where AI came from and found almost two hundred years of a real science, built leap after leap by women the textbook forgot to name.
tryOn: Give the work assistant and one personal assistant the same low-risk task, then compare the answers and identify the app versus the model.
mainCharacterEnergy: I stopped asking which one was best and started asking which store I was walking into.
rememberLine: The company makes the model; the app is just where you shop it.
